title: The log is the product
prompt: Prepare a scratch workspace: a notes folder with today's todo file, and show me what's in it

steps.command_string: mkdir -p notes && printf -- '- [ ] write the launch post\n- [ ] record the demo\n' > notes/todo.md

intro: Security by recording, not by asking
every tool call, policy decision and engine step is written down
open: The action log, inside the panel
app and engine entries, one file, newest last
filter: the engine's graph nodes are entries too
expand: Expand a row for the full detail
command, cwd, exit code, output tail
verify: each entry hashes the one before it: ✓ intact
tamper: Now edit one line of the log file on disk…
a single character changed in o-actions.jsonl
broken: Verify chain again: ✗ broken at the edited entry
nothing before it is affected; everything after is unverified

reply: Your scratch workspace is ready: `notes/todo.md` with two items.
